projects.name: Uttaree Electronics
projects.summary: Retail and servicing of home appliances and electronic products, based in Dhaka.
about: Uttaree Electronics sells and services home appliances in Dhaka, including televisions and refrigerators.
The venture opened in 2026. A project director and an assistant director lead it for the year. Customers reach the work through the Uttaree office.
projects.quote: Practical electronics, sold and serviced under the Uttaree name.

projects.name: Uttaree Agro
projects.summary: Crop production, organic farming, and agro consultancy in Rangpur.
about: Uttaree Agro is the group's farming venture. The work covers crop production, organic farming, consultancy, and practical agri-support for the Rangpur area.
This was the first venture, started in 2024. A new project director and assistant director are selected for it each year.

projects.name: Uttaree Art School
projects.summary: Fine-art classes, digital design training, workshops, and student exhibitions.
about: Uttaree Art School teaches drawing, painting, and digital design, and holds workshops and exhibitions. The studio is at Shukurer Hat, Mithapukur.
Families and students should use the Uttaree office number for admission questions. The school's yearly committee is published here by name and role only.
projects.quote: A place to learn drawing, design, and how to show the work.
